messages.subject: Marginal Frequency Table format
parts:
Hi,
     I was hoping on rendering a marginal frequency table to look nice. When I convert the table from crosstab() to Table() it messes up the format. Is there a way to keep the frequency table formatted correctly?



###########################################################################
################################# UI ######################################
###########################################################################

# First we load the required packages
library(shiny) # for the website functions
library(DT)    # For the tabling functions

### Create some data to play with ###
Individual <- 1:1000
Population <- rep.int(c("Adult", "Children"), 500)
Bloodcount <- rnorm(1000, mean = 500, sd = 56 )  # Random Blood counts
Exp <- rbinom(n=1000, size=1, prob=0.5)  # Random 1/0's
Disease <- rbinom(n=1000, size=1, prob=0.22) # Random 1/0s
Data <- data.frame(Individual, Population, Bloodcount, Exp, Disease) # put all of this into a dataset called Data

# Define User Interface 
ui <- fluidPage(
  
  # Application title
  titlePanel("Marginal Crosstable example"),
  
  # Sidebar with a slider input for number of bins 
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(  )                                                    # Start to create the sidepanel


    mainPanel(
      
      
      tableOutput('Table')       # output the Table
      
    )      # Close mainpanel
  )      # Close sidebar
)       ## Close UI   



###########################################################################
#############################  Server  ####################################
###########################################################################


server <- function(input, output) {
  source("http://pcwww.liv.ac.uk/~william/R/crosstab.r")                                                    # Import the crossTable function
  
  # Create the Table
  output$Table <- renderTable({
                                             
                                             Table.Data   <- crosstab(Data, row.vars = "Exp", col.vars = "Disease", type = "f")                     # Create the crosstab table
    
                                            Table.Data$"table"                                                                                                                            # Produce the table
    
  })

  
  } # Close Server end

shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
